fields.title: Design an error
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: For each code on the checkout screen, state: what to show, whether to retry automatically, whether to log as failure.
fields.promptBlocks/1/text: `401` · `409` item out of stock · `422` address out of zone · `429` · `503` · timeout
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: `401` — login prompt preserving cart, do not retry, not a failure. `409` — "item no longer available" with remove button, do not retry, not a failure. `422` — message near address field, do not retry, not a failure. `429` — "too frequent", retry with delay, log as suspicious. `503` — "overloaded", auto-retry, log as failure. Timeout — worst case: unknown if it went through; retry only if idempotency key exists, show "checking status", log. Rule: first "can the person fix it themselves", then "is retry safe".
